answer: Burned admission auction: each epoch the network opens one narrow inlet of just 20 new identity seats, sold by sealed-bid auction, and every winning bid is burned rather than paid to anyone. If honest demand clears near 15 POA a seat, a farm wanting 200 clones must outbid real newcomers for ten straight epochs and burn at least 3,000 POA, so cost rises with every fake. A falcon-eyed auditor can check the full atlas of burns on the ledger, so no seat slips in free.
